title: capabilities.radicle
description: The `radicle` provider's block (new in freedom-manifest/2). At least one key is required. See providers/radicle.md §6.

node.description: radicle:node — radicle_seed, radicle_unseed, radicle_sync (per-call; always-allow = node auto-approve; unseed of a user-seeded repo always prompts).

signing.description: radicle:signing — radicle_getIdentity and every collaborative-object write, as the user's single Radicle identity (per-call; always-allow = signing auto-approve).
